svg.title: United States Reference Map
svg.desc: A static map showing US state borders - continental US, plus Alaska and Hawaii insets - generated from Natural Earth public-domain data.

g.text: United States Reference Map - state borders, three independently-scaled panels
Data: Natural Earth 1:110m Admin 1 States/Provinces (public domain, naturalearthdata.com), filtered to US. Alaska/Hawaii insets are NOT to the same scale as the continental panel.
